title: KnowledgeSourceDescriptor
description: Declarative metadata for a Knowledge Source (KS). Loaded by Control without invoking the KS.

writesSlots.description: Slot names this KS writes (only meaningful for L1 KSs).

readsLevels.description: Levels this KS reads. Invariant: every read level <= writesLevel (with SOURCE_CONTEXT < L0).

triggerPredicate.description: Tiny declarative DSL evaluated by Control. Read-only structural checks; no side effects, no method calls. Example: 'level == L1 && archetypeRefs? && !statement?'

dependsOn.description: Explicit upstream KS dependencies. Control will not fire this KS for a hypothesis lineage until all dependsOn KSs have either contributed or declared SKIP.

determinismDefault.description: Default determinism class. Per-Contribution overrides allowed (a KS may emit DETERMINISTIC and NON_DETERMINISTIC contributions).

parallelSafe.description: If true, Control may invoke this KS in parallel with other parallelSafe KSs whose read/write sets do not overlap on the same hypothesis.

defmanReadScope.description: If defmanExplorationNeeded, the engine restricts DefManExplorationService to these archetype URIs.

implementationClass.description: Fully-qualified Java class name implementing the KnowledgeSource interface.
